name: Base64
description: Asks the AI to answer in base64 (and encodes your message), then decodes the reply; small mistakes in the base64 are repaired unless set to strict. "Decode base64" is under every reply, even when it's off.

settings.label: Instruction added to the message
settings.default: Reply with base64 only: encode your whole answer as UTF-8 base64. No plain text, no code block, no explanation outside the base64.

settings.label: Strict (fail on any damage instead of repairing)
Show the raw reply if decoding fails
